title: Ask clearly and check the result
objectives: Write a request with context, task and output format
Separate a supplied fact from an unsupported claim
Improve a draft without sharing private information

quiz.prompt: Which request gives an assistant the clearest task?

options.text: Using the three supplied agenda items, draft a friendly meeting reminder under 80 words. Do not invent a time or location.

quiz.prompt: Your notes say Tuesday, but the generated reminder adds 10:00. What should you do?

options.text: Assume the assistant looked up the calendar
Accept it because the wording sounds confident
Remove or flag the time and verify it with the organizer

quiz.prompt: You want help improving a customer reply. What is the best starting input for this exercise?

options.text: An invented or redacted example containing only the details needed for the task
Your account password so the assistant can read everything

quiz.prompt: An answer includes a source link. Does that alone verify its claim?

options.text: No; open the original source and check that it supports the claim and is relevant
Yes, if the answer is long
